q: ✅ Minimum 3–5 years in a CFO, Deputy CFO, VP Finance or equivalent senior leadership position.
✅ Strong experience in FinTech, Financial Services, Investment, Brokerage or Capital Markets.
✅ In-depth knowledge of Kuwait CMA regulations and regulatory reporting.
✅ Strong expertise in financial planning, treasury, IFRS, risk management and internal controls.
✅ Experience presenting to CEOs, board members, investors and regulators.
✅ CPA / ACCA / CA / CFA qualification would be an added advantage.
r: 🔹 Lead the company's overall financial strategy, planning, budgeting and forecasting.
🔹 Oversee financial reporting, treasury, cash flow and capital management.
🔹 Ensure compliance with Kuwait Capital Markets Authority (CMA) regulations and reporting requirements.
🔹 Manage relationships with regulators, external auditors, investors and banking partners.
🔹 Strengthen internal financial controls, risk management and financial governance.
🔹 Support fundraising, investor relations, business expansion and strategic decision-making.
🔹 Build and lead a high-performing finance team.
